visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length dark hair and glasses, wearing a white collared shirt under a purple apron, stands in a brightly lit kitchen. She uses a chef's knife to slice green scallions into segments on a yellow cutting board. In the background, a large stainless steel pot sits on an induction stove. (2) The woman picks up a bunch of green leaves and skillfully ties them into a large knot with her hands. She presents the green knot to the camera. (3) The perspective shifts to a close-up of the yellow cutting board where ginger is being sliced into thin, translucent rounds. (4) The woman uses the flat side of the knife to firmly crush garlic cloves. She then slices a large white onion into thick strips. (5) In a metal strainer, pieces of raw sea bass bones and heads are displayed. The woman then reveals a tray of fresh, silver-skinned sea bass fillets, which she seasons with salt from her fingers. (6) Onions and fish bones are transferred into the large pressure cooker pot. The woman pours olive oil from a glass bottle and adds the green scallion knots, ginger, and garlic. Salt and pepper are sprinkled from a wooden spoon. (7) Liquid is poured into the pot from a stainless steel pitcher. The woman secures the lid of the pressure cooker and attaches a pink pressure valve on top. (8) While the pot heats on the stove, the woman resumes chopping green onions into fine bits. The pressure valve begins to rattle and spin. (9) The lid is opened to reveal a clear yellow broth. After further boiling, the liquid transforms into a cloudy, milky white soup. The woman pours the broth through a fine mesh strainer into a large metal bowl, using a spoon to press the remaining solids. (10) The concentrated broth is poured into a small brown ceramic pot on a portable stove. Tofu cubes, clams, fish fillets, shrimp, and noodles are added sequentially. (11) The final dish of fish soup noodles is garnished with fresh greens. The woman sits at a table with anime plushies in the background, smiling broadly as she lifts a large portion of noodles with chopsticks and takes a bite.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 青蔥或蒜苗切成段. (2) [Subtitle]: 蒜苗葉打個結. (3) [Subtitle]: 像這樣... (4) [Subtitle]: 切幾片薑片. (5) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭拍裂開來 去掉皮.. (6) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥兩顆 切成粗絲... (7) [Subtitle]: 準備兩份鱸魚骨 包括魚頭.. (8) [Subtitle]: 你可以請攤商老闆 幫你處理成魚片.. 會很方便料理. (9) [Subtitle]: 在魚片上 兩面灑上鹽. (10) [Subtitle]: 先放冷藏備用. (11) [Subtitle]: 將切好的洋蔥跟魚骨 放到壓力鍋裡... (12) [Subtitle]: 一些橄欖油 （增加湯滑順感）. (13) [Subtitle]: 再放入蒜苗... (14) [Subtitle]: 薑片、蒜頭. (15) [Subtitle]: 一匙鹽、一匙胡椒粒. (16) [Subtitle]: 適量的酒... (17) [Subtitle]: 2000~2200ml的水. (18) [Subtitle]: 蓋上壓力鍋蓋 放上壓力閥... (19) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱. (20) [Subtitle]: 等壓力閥開始搖後，火轉小一點，計時6分鐘 接著關火，等待洩壓. (21) [Subtitle]: 等待的時候來切點蔥花 切點豆腐... (22) [Subtitle]: 好囉~開蓋！ (23) [Subtitle]: 現在的湯是清澈感！ (24) [Subtitle]: 再次開中小火加熱 讓湯一直滾沸狀態 大約10分鐘. (25) [Subtitle]: 直到湯呈現混濁不透明感 就可以關火了！ (26) [Subtitle]: 用過濾網把湯過濾出來. (27) [Subtitle]: 上面這些料 用力擠壓出湯汁 不要浪費了！ (28) [Subtitle]: 湯汁再倒回來. (29) [Subtitle]: 非常簡單又濃郁的魚高湯 就完成了！ (30) [Subtitle]: 你可以分裝在冷凍庫保存！ (31) [Subtitle]: 取用約500~600ml的魚高湯 （可加一點水稀釋濃度）. (32) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽調味. (33) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後轉小火. (34) [Subtitle]: 放入嫩豆腐、適量的蛤蜊. (35) [Subtitle]: 煮到蛤蜊開口即可. (36) [Subtitle]: 放入切片的鱸魚 維持小火不要煮滾！ (37) [Subtitle]: 加入半熟的麵條. (38) [Subtitle]: 也可放幾隻蝦仁. (39) [Subtitle]: 一點青菜 或者任何喜歡的食材. (40) [Subtitle]: 把魚肉慢慢燙熟 撒上蔥花 就可以關火囉！ (41) [Subtitle]: 像這樣~ 超簡單的鱸魚豆腐湯煨麵 就完成啦~ ❤️. (42) [Subtitle]: 鱸魚用泡熟的方式 魚肉超級嫩！！ ❤️. (43) [Subtitle]: 魚湯非常地鮮美好喝 ❤️. (44) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉~ ❤️. (45) [Subtitle]: 這個魚湯太好喝了 鱸魚超嫩超好吃！ ❤️. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar-driven pop background music. The dominant female speaker introduces the cooking process with a friendly and clear tone. (2) Rapid percussive thudding sounds are heard, representing the fast-paced chopping of scallions on a wooden surface. (3) A loud, singular metallic thud marks the smashing of garlic with a knife. (4) The music continues as the speaker describes preparing ingredients, punctuated by the faint sound of liquid pouring into a pot. (5) A rhythmic hissing and rattling sound enters the mix, signifying the steam and vibration of the pressure cooker valve. (6) Bubbling and sizzling liquid sounds become prominent as the broth boils vigorously. (7) High-frequency clinking of metal utensils against a pot occurs during the straining phase. (8) The female speaker's tone remains warm and instructional throughout the assembly of the noodle bowl. (9) Soft slurping and eating sounds are heard as the speaker tastes the final dish, accompanied by a bright, cheerful musical resolution.
